verdict.rationale: Genuine machine-to-machine channels exist: MeF is a system-to-system XML e-file rail, and IRIS offers an Application-to-Application intake for information returns. Both are gated behind credentialing (Authorized e-file Provider enrollment taking up to 45 days with possible fingerprinting, plus a Transmitter Control Code). The consumer-facing services (EIN assistant, Online Account, signed forms) are interactive-only, with ID.me biometric liveness, 15-minute sessions and business-hour windows, and probes found no OpenAPI spec while the Form 15620 entry returned 403 to an automated agent. missing for 10: publicly accessible API or CLI for headless use, documented CI/automation workflows, non-interactive auth for online account services, machine access to EIN and online form flows without provider enrollment.
